item.title: MI5 warns UK defence companies of Russian attacks on staff
item.body: British businesses are being told their own staff are at risk of Russian attacks and that they must improve security. The warnings are being given in an unprecedented series of emergency briefings this week.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚨 MI5 warns UK defence companies of Russian attacks on staff

British businesses are being told their own staff are at risk of Russian attacks and that they must improve security. The warnings are being given in an unprecedented series of emergency briefings this week.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 24 November, 14:20
